chunks.content: PHC Yelahanka (Bengaluru Rural): Provides NCD screening, BP/diabetes check, free medicines, and referral. Address: Yelahanka New Town, Bengaluru. Open Mon-Sat 9am-4pm. Services: NCD clinic on Wednesdays.

CHC Devanahalli: Community Health Centre with doctor, lab, and emergency stabilization. Refer here if PHC cannot manage your condition. Has teleconsultation facility. Address: Devanahalli, Bengaluru Rural. Open 24/7 for emergencies.

Ayushman Arogya Mandir: Primary point for NCD screening and basic care. Free BP and blood sugar check. Available in most villages. Ask your ASHA worker for the nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir location.

For cardiac emergency or stroke: Go directly to District Hospital or call 108 for free ambulance. Do NOT go to PHC for heart attack — go to a facility with cardiac care. Victoria Hospital Bengaluru and Jayadeva Institute are referral centers for cardiac emergencies.
Government PHC services: Free NCD medicines (amlodipine, metformin, etc.), quarterly follow-up, lab tests, referral slips, and maternal-child health. NCD clinic days vary — ask at your PHC reception.
